snippet.title: GetClipMachine
snippet.description:
GetClipMachine turns long videos into short, ready-to-post clips for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels.

Paste a YouTube, Twitch or Kick link, or upload a file. Our AI finds the best moments, cuts them into vertical 9:16 clips, adds word-by-word captions and keeps the speaker in frame. You get up to 12 clips per video, each with a score and the reason it was picked.

One flat price, no credits. Pro is €20 a month (US$20 in the Americas) for unlimited videos up to 3 hours each. Try it free with 3 videos a month, no card needed.

On this channel: tutorials, product updates and clipping tips for streamers, podcasters and clippers.

Start free: https://getclipmachine.com

Building businesses from zero, in public. Real numbers, real mistakes, new video every Sunday.

I’m Théo, a physiotherapist from France. I built and ran a private clinic in Oslo, and now I’m starting new ventures from scratch, including a web design agency, with the goal of building something scalable that doesn’t depend on my time.

If you’re starting a business, thinking about leaving a stable career to build something of your own, or just want to see what building from zero actually looks like, subscribe and start with the first video.
